title_en: Floor Area Ratio (FAR) by use group — Table 8
title_hi: उपयोग समूह के अनुसार फर्श क्षेत्र अनुपात (FAR) — तालिका 8
interpretation_notes: Table 8 is applied to buildings up to 12.5 m; taller buildings use Rule 42 Tables 4/5. FAR achieved = total built-up area / plot area. The table footnote says FAR and density may be adopted as provided in the Development Plan (see also Rule 103) — shown as a note on every FAR result. Premium FAR (61(7)) up to 25% of base FAR is discretionary: values above base FAR but within 1.25 × base go to manual review. FAR exemptions in notes (1)–(6) (servant quarters, covered parking, EWS/LIG, slum redevelopment) are not encoded.

exceptions.text_en: Premium FAR up to 25% of the base FAR may be provided at rates decided by the State Government (61(7)).
exceptions.text_hi: आधार FAR के 25% तक प्रीमियम FAR राज्य सरकार द्वारा तय दर पर दिया जा सकता है (61(7))।
exceptions.quote: In addition to the FAR as mentioned in above said table, additional FAR as Premium Floor Area Ratio may be provided over and above which shall not exceed 25% of the Base FAR.

notes_en: FAR and density may be adopted as provided in the Development Plan of the town.
notes_hi: FAR और घनत्व नगर की विकास योजना के अनुसार अपनाए जा सकते हैं।
